title: Audit all 46 relay recodings with exact bank bases and complete signed delta
body:
This enabling audit verifies all 46 fixed recodings in [PR #7708](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7708), including the requested division by five at cut 38 and chart-778 changes at cuts 40–42. It checks every surviving bank and public output against a separate exact entrance-basis expansion, then joins the native delta to the complete signed caller. **No new kappa is claimed.**

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6de456fff16721021227f9e5464cd9ba4a366348/research/relay-recoding-basis-audit/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6de456fff16721021227f9e5464cd9ba4a366348/research/relay-recoding-basis-audit/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6de456fff16721021227f9e5464cd9ba4a366348/research/relay-recoding-basis-audit/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6de456fff16721021227f9e5464cd9ba4a366348/research/relay-recoding-basis-audit/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6de456fff16721021227f9e5464cd9ba4a366348/research/relay-recoding-basis-audit/CREDITS.md). This answers the [specific receiver handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19710692).

The audit checks **350,961 bank/output values and 468,916,850 exact coefficient products**, with all 1,501 entrance coordinates available. At cut 38, the corrected receiver equation is `5Y=S+2h100694-2h'100744`; at input owner 2 its numerator has coefficient five and Y has coefficient one. At cut 40, the signal is `-x18/2+x55/2-x101/2+x447/2+x468`. Cut 42 proves a second sender representation of that same signal and removes the intermediate paid bank. Every intervening and later cut is checked in order, including transposed cuts.

| Complete signed quantity | Parent | Candidate |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Paid calls | 101,840 | 101,488 |
| Productive targets | 21,152 | 21,152 |
| Paid rank mass | 271,568 | 271,568 |
| Productive rank mass | 272,896 | 272,896 |

The 352 removed paid calls are `16*22`. The exact count delta has negative cumulative tails and zero rank-weighted sum, which proves a strict paid-power improvement for every exponent `0<t<1`. All fixed caller jobs and root targets are included. The source's numerical crossing and complete conditional application are unchanged; this audit does not rerun the compiler or infer a historical hosted-coverage ceiling for the sixteen-stage independent-helper contract.

Base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The consumed PR7708 scientific commit is `f0e2db5b5b46b139da17d2b32fab6633164443a9`, published head `7017edbe4bc5ed1b6d5b6defedbc7e472d83c65c`. The parent constructor comes from [PR #7704](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7704) at `e29a5ae8591243c1178067727f12ce4abefa0b93`. The unchanged basis engine comes from [PR #7715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7715) at `4517ad2a3e9f06ca369a2625f652de4f57be2fb9`; that audit trusted the already recoded parent and did not check these 46 cuts. All 23 retained source files have original Git blob and SHA-256 pins. The complete package runs without predecessor checkouts or network.

Use CPython 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/relay-recoding-basis-audit
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_ALL_RECODING_BANK_BASES 46 350961
```

Normal and optimized replay pass. All 46 altered literal coefficients produce nonzero entrance residuals, and all three changed feedback denominators fail their recovery equations. These are equation controls. Exact source bytes, committed bytes/modes, source history, package export, sealed read-only Git-free replay, public links and rendered publication readback pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44357853635/job/134990709086) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

The original word, CLEAR certificates and role-1256 constructor remain inherited dependencies. The full native phase catalogue, physical storage, root precision, compiler, complete predecessor suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not rerun. All five framework interfaces remain assumptions. The source was read and its transformation and caller code are reused; this is author checking, not blind, independent human or formal-kernel acceptance. No selected-frontier or other contributor's PR change is included.

Credit Ali Romman for the source certificates and basis engine; Clear1nsight for the banked relay; SYLforge for the word/caller; DreamingOfClouds for the related grouped-hub method and separate parent reconstruction; Rohan Arun, Jerry Chen / CubeJerry, Douglas Colkitt, mightyOil and the retained contributors for the framework. [PR #7712](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7712) is related corroboration, not a consumed checker. All original notices remain. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.
